lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
Shopping and cooking first thing in the morning, so it is ready by lunch.
Shopping happens 2 times: Friday and Saturday. The later trips are there so fresh food does not wait for the pan.
What is cooked on Sunday is bought close to that day: fresh meat or fish from the first shop would not keep that long.
The shared base is vegan: that is Lea's line, and they have their own box. The rest of the table keeps theirs.
Everyone has every one of their meals.
The shares in this plan are served at the plate, as close as they can be, rather than adjusted mouth by mouth.

dishes.name: Fresh green egg plate
dishes.title: Eggs, tofu, spinach and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed egg and tofu portions, then add the spinach and tomatoes. Keep Anna's portion boxed first and use clean equipment between dishes.
dishes.why: A quick, colourful breakfast built from familiar foods.

dishes.name: Theo's egg breakfast
dishes.title: Eggs, spinach, tomatoes and toast
dishes.method: Take Theo's closed box from the fridge, reheat the egg portion, and add the spinach, tomatoes and toast.
dishes.why: A familiar breakfast that is ready with little morning work.

dishes.title: Apple and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Slice the apple and serve with the sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A portable mid-morning bite using autumn fruit.

dishes.name: Theo's apple snack
dishes.title: Apple and oat drink
dishes.method: Pour the oat drink and serve with the apple.
dishes.why: A simple snack that travels well.

dishes.name: Roast chicken flatbread
dishes.title: Chicken, tofu, roasted vegetables and flatbread
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, tofu and roasted vegetables, then add the flatbread, rocket and lemon. Anna's food is boxed first on clean equipment before the other portions are handled.
dishes.why: A warm, quick lunch with a fresh seasonal salad element.

dishes.name: Theo's chicken flatbread
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables and flatbread
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's boxed chicken and vegetables, then add the flatbread and rocket.
dishes.why: A practical lunch assembled from the first cooking session.

dishes.name: Berry oat cup
dishes.title: Berries, oats and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Stir the oats and oat drink together and top with blackberries and sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A cool afternoon snack suited to late-summer produce.

dishes.name: Theo's banana shake
dishes.title: Oat drink, oats, banana and sunflower seed butter
dishes.method: Blend everything until smooth and pour into one tall glass.
dishes.why: A drinkable snack made in minutes.

dishes.name: Herb chicken bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, potatoes, roasted vegetables and greens
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, potatoes and vegetables, then add rocket and lemon.
dishes.why: A warm first-night dinner that uses the fresh batch efficiently.

dishes.name: Theo's herb chicken bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, potatoes and roasted vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's closed box until hot and serve.
dishes.why: A filling dinner with no extra cooking.

dishes.name: Tomato egg toast
dishes.title: Eggs, spinach, tomatoes and wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Reheat the egg and tofu portions and add the vegetables and toast.
dishes.why: A different presentation of the prepared breakfast base.

dishes.name: Theo's tomato egg toast
dishes.title: Eggs, tomatoes and wholemeal toast
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's boxed egg portion and add tomatoes and toast.
dishes.why: A familiar breakfast with a crisp fresh side.

dishes.name: Pear and seeds
dishes.title: Pear and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Slice the pear and serve with sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: An easy seasonal snack with no cooking.

dishes.name: Theo's pear snack
dishes.title: Pear and oat drink
dishes.method: Pour the oat drink and serve with the pear.
dishes.why: A quick snack for a regular eating time.

dishes.name: Roast chicken potato salad
dishes.title: Chicken, tofu, potatoes, roasted vegetables and salad leaves
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, tofu, potatoes and vegetables, then add salad leaves, lemon and olive oil.
dishes.why: The same batch becomes a lighter salad-style lunch.

dishes.name: Theo's chicken potato salad
dishes.title: Chicken, potatoes, roasted vegetables and salad leaves
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's boxed chicken, potatoes and vegetables, then add the salad leaves.
dishes.why: A fresh variation on the prepared lunch.

dishes.name: Plum and oats
dishes.title: Plum, oats and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Cut the plums and serve with oats and sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: Seasonal fruit keeps the afternoon bite simple.

dishes.name: Theo's plum shake
dishes.title: Oat drink, plums and oats
dishes.method: Blend the oat drink, stoned plums and oats until smooth.
dishes.why: A drinkable afternoon snack with seasonal fruit.

dishes.name: Barley roast dinner
dishes.title: Chicken, tofu, potatoes, roasted vegetables and barley
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, tofu, potatoes and vegetables, then add barley and parsley.
dishes.why: A comforting dinner that changes the texture of the earlier roast.

dishes.name: Theo's barley roast
dishes.title: Chicken, potatoes, roasted vegetables and barley
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's boxed chicken, potatoes and vegetables, then add barley.
dishes.why: A hearty dinner assembled from the batch.

dishes.name: Mushroom egg toast
dishes.title: Eggs, tofu, mushrooms, tomatoes and toast
dishes.method: Use the boxed egg and tofu portions and add the sliced mushrooms, tomatoes and toast. Box Anna's portion first on clean equipment.
dishes.why: A final breakfast variation uses fresh mushrooms and the prepared protein.

dishes.name: Theo's mushroom eggs
dishes.title: Eggs, mushrooms, tomatoes and toast
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's boxed egg portion and add the mushrooms, tomatoes and toast.
dishes.why: A warm breakfast ready from the fridge.

dishes.name: Berry apple cup
dishes.title: Apple, blackberries and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Cut the apple and serve with blackberries and sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A fresh Sunday snack with local-style late-summer fruit.

dishes.name: Theo's berry cup
dishes.title: Apple, blackberries and oat drink
dishes.method: Pour the oat drink and serve with the apple and blackberries.
dishes.why: A quick snack that needs no cooking.

dishes.name: Chicken barley wrap
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables, barley and flatbread
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed chicken, vegetables and barley, then wrap with the flatbread and rocket.
dishes.why: A portable lunch that gives the roast batch a new form.

dishes.name: Theo's chicken wrap
dishes.title: Chicken, roasted vegetables, barley and flatbread
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's boxed chicken, vegetables and barley, then add the flatbread and rocket.
dishes.why: A convenient final lunch from the batch.

dishes.name: Plum and oat bowl
dishes.title: Plums, oats and sunflower seeds
dishes.method: Slice the plums and serve with oats and sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A no-cook afternoon bite before dinner.

dishes.name: Theo's banana oat shake
dishes.title: Oat drink, banana, oats and sunflower seed butter
dishes.method: Blend everything until smooth and pour into one tall glass.
dishes.why: The requested drinkable snack is fast and easy to repeat.

dishes.name: Lemon salmon tray
dishes.title: Salmon, potatoes, roasted vegetables and barley
dishes.method: Reheat the boxed salmon, potatoes, vegetables and barley, then add lemon and rocket. Buy the fresh fish today or yesterday.
dishes.why: A fresh fish dinner gives the weekend a clear change from chicken.

dishes.name: Theo's lemon salmon
dishes.title: Salmon, potatoes, roasted vegetables and barley
dishes.method: Reheat Theo's boxed salmon, potatoes, vegetables and barley, then add lemon.
dishes.why: A simple fresh-fish Sunday dinner.

preparations.title: Herb baked eggs
preparations.method: Whisk the eggs with chives, pour into an oiled baking dish and bake until just set. Cool, portion and close the boxes.

preparations.title: Baked lemon tofu
preparations.method: Press and cube the tofu, toss with oil and lemon, bake until browned, then portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Roast chicken thighs
preparations.method: Coat the chicken with oil and oregano, roast until cooked through, rest, slice and portion into boxes.

preparations.title: Late-summer roast vegetables
preparations.method: Cut the vegetables, toss with oil and roast until tender. Cool and portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Roasted baby potatoes
preparations.method: Halve the potatoes, toss with oil, roast until tender and portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Cooked pearl barley
preparations.method: Rinse the barley, simmer in water until tender, drain well, cool quickly and portion into boxes.

preparations.title: Lemon roast salmon
preparations.method: Buy the fresh salmon today or yesterday. Oil and lemon the fillets, roast until just cooked, cool promptly and portion into the named boxes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Wash hands and equipment, make Anna's egg portion first on clean equipment, close that box, then bake the tofu. Put the potatoes and vegetables into the oven, prepare the chicken beside them, simmer the barley while they cook, cool everything and portion it into the named boxes.
Buy the fresh fish today or yesterday, wash the equipment, roast the salmon, cool it promptly and portion it into the named boxes.
